applicable_to: hotels, motels, inns, and similar lodging; law enforcement; healthcare providers; schools; foster parents; and youth
recordkeeping_requirements: guest transactions and receipts for at least six months
harbor_alliance_actions: Implement regular trainings on human trafficking for all relevant industries and professionals

Strengthen enforcement mechanisms to hold individuals accountable for human trafficking violations, including commercial sexual exploitation of minors
